openingBalances.title: Account Opening Balances
openingBalances.subtitle: Set or adjust initial opening balances for Main Cashier (Cash in Hand), Bank Operational Accounts, and Petty Cash Impress float.
openingBalances.cashInHandHelp: Physical currency held by the principal / cashier at the beginning of the financial period.
openingBalances.pettyCashHelp: Initial imprest float allocated to the petty cashier for minor daily expenses.
openingBalances.bankAccountsHelp: Initial cleared balance in active institutional bank accounts at the beginning of the financial period.
openingBalances.noBankAccounts: No active bank accounts found. Register a bank account in Bank Accounts view first.
openingBalances.saveSuccess: Account opening balances saved and financial ledgers synchronized successfully.

dangerZone.title: Danger Zone: Factory Reset Application
dangerZone.subtitle: Permanently erase all institutional accounts, financial years, ledger vouchers, cheques, and user records. System will reset to fresh installation state.
dangerZone.modalWarning: WARNING: This action is permanent and completely irreversible. All transactional records, receipts, bank accounts, vouchers, and staff accounts will be permanently destroyed.
dangerZone.confirmationCheckbox: I confirm that I want to completely erase all data and reset the application.
